title: Merida China SCULTURA 6000 positioning recheck
notes: Exact mainland page calls SCULTURA a classic road racer (经典的公路赛车) with race-certified geometry shared with REACTO and WorldTour development, an all-rounder for flats, hills and mountains with industry-leading climbing ability, and a lightweight CF3 frame of about 997 g in M. Lower-drag tube claims are framed as improvements, not aero-road positioning; no maximum tire clearance is stated.
